consequence.remediation: Change engineVersion to an allowed value (e.g. remove v1 setting) before applying.

assertion.statement: The value "v1" is removed from the allowed enum of spec.target.template.engineVersion in the ExternalSecret external-secrets.io/v1beta1 schema, so ExternalSecrets setting engineVersion: v1 are rejected by the API server.
